text:
Sam: Thanks everyone for joining the all-hands. Quick follow-up from the sales debrief — can folks drop 1-2 bullets on why we won or lost deals this quarter and any concrete asks for leadership? Keep it short.

Diego: Won: strong latency + predictable pricing for a fintech buyer. Lost: feature parity on a specific proprietary tool (signal routing). Ask: can we commit to a concise decision doc on roadmap priority for signal features?

Avery: Lost a mid-market account — they wanted an easy on-prem installer. We can pitch Private but setup looked heavy. Ask: make a "zero-friction" Private quickstart (1 pager + script).

Priya: Technical win theme: KV cache + batching reduced token costs in POC, customers loved the demo numbers. Ask: add an official benchmark snippet we can paste in PRDs.

Lina: CS feedback: wins come from observability — customers cite Console traces as the reason they trusted us. Losses: security controls (KMS/HSM) still a checklist blocker for larger enterprises. Ask: timeline on managed KMS integrations?

Jordan: SE perspective: demo confusion around model variants and fallbacks. Customers asked "which model for my use case?" Ask: usable quick guide "which model to pick" with 3 categories (latency, cost, quality).

Mali: Customer anecdote: a health startup selected us after a small offline eval where dedupe + caching cut costs 30%. They flagged docs clarity as decisive. Ask: prioritize updating the caching docs and examples.

Diego: Another loss note: procurement friction on committed capacity contracts — legal RTOs and billing cadence. Ask: sales + legal sync to standardize a mid-market-friendly contract template.

Sam: Noted. I'll loop in legal + product. Quick clarity: are the asks here (quickstart, benchmark snippet, KMS timeline, model guide, contract template) the right list? Say +1 to confirm or add a short item.

Avery: +1 for the list. Add: better onboarding checklist in Console for Private deployments (minimal steps + expected time).

Priya: +1. I'll draft the benchmark snippet with perf numbers and a short how-to for SEs.

Lina: +1 and I'll prioritize the KMS timeline ask with Security — will post an ETA in #eng-security by EOD Friday.

Jordan: +1; I can draft the 3-tier model guide this week, will post in #eng-ml for review.

ops-bot: Reminder: all-hands follow-up survey goes out in 10 minutes.

Sam: Great thread — I'll convert these asks into a triage board and ping owners tomorrow. If anyone has short customer quotes (1-2 lines) add them here so we can cite in PRDs. :thumbsup:
